name: Wildheart
description:
You felt its presence when you communed with the forest this morning: the source of the blight is just inside this cave. You test your sharpened nails against a boulder and narrow your eyes as you stride into the darkness. You feel the mycelia on your shoulders stir and strengthen in the damp dark, emitting a faint glow visible in your peripheral vision. There - a skittering shadow just darted across that opening ahead. You perk up your ears and hear movement on all sides of you now. You won't have to go looking for them, they've brought the fight to you. A roar and a lunge from behind you is followed by a smack and a crash before you can turn around - the plant living in your backpack defended you without prompting, and is now waving its spiny tendrils threateningly. Your heart rate rises and your shoulders bloom with glowing mushrooms. You see dozens of eyes glittering in the dark on all sides. You can hold your own, but you're stronger with your pack. You lift your head and let out a wild howl that sends the eyes staggering backward for a moment, and as you bare your teeth and square up with your foes, you hear your reinforcements approaching from behind, with a thunder of hooves, paws and wings.

A Wildheart wields the magic that lies within the natural world. Their connection with nature allows them to draw out and control the plants, animals and natural systems around them, forming symbiotic bonds that make them almost an ecosystem in and of themselves.

The Wildheart mestiere uses the environment as a resource, remaining in constant contact with the living things around them. Your Wild Attunement ability represents this connection. Further abilities allow you to communicate with and request help from animals, and your Wild Shape ability allows you to take an animal form.

From there, you may advance along one or more of the four Ways of the Wildheart:

  • Way of the Green strengthens your connection with plants. You carry with you a Ward Plant which protects you, and other abilities allow you to call elements of the plant kingdom to your aid, or even magically transport yourself through its wide-reaching network.

  • Way of the Hive strengthens your connection with insects. You carry a colony of insects with you on your person, which gives you an intimidating presence and which you can send out to harry your enemies.

  • Way of the Spore strengthens your connection with fungi. You carry with you mycelial symbiotes, which have both the power to heal you and to sicken others.

  • Way of the Tooth strengthens your connection with animals. You yourself gain some of the traits of a predator, and other abilities allow you to form a lasting bond with a large animal, shapeshift into fierce creatures, and gather a pack of companion animals.

You may progress as far down each of these ways as you choose, defining your unique connection with nature.

More often than any other Mestiere, Wildheart abilities are influenced by the current biome - the natural environment you are in. See "Biome Influence" in the Abilities rules section.

Wildheart brings the natural world to the battlefield, pulling magic out of the living things that surround us.

Play a Wildheart if you want to:

  • Reshape the battlefield with the living world, directing roots, vines, insects, and animals as extensions of your own intent.

  • Become one with nature, taking on a predator's form, hosting a colony on insects, bearing a ward plant, and/or inoculating your flesh with mycelium.

  • Stay in tune with the natural world, gathering information, requesting aid, and feeling your abilities amplified as you travel through different biomes.

Questions to consider when making a Wildheart:

  • Which aspect of nature called to them first — predation, growth, the collective, or decay — and did they choose it, or did it choose them?

  • Does their attunement show in small ways - animals that follow without being called, predicting the weather without looking up - or something more obvious?

  • What is their relationship to civilization? Do they move through it as a visitor, or have they found ways to carry the wild into humanoid spaces?

  • How does their unusual appearance affect those around them? How do they feel about that effect? Do they use it?

  • Who or what was the first wild creature they truly understood, and what did they learn from it?

novizio.description: You have cultivated a magical affinity with the natural world, and you have set out on one of the Ways of the Wildheart.
novizio.abilities:
Wild Attunement and any combination of other Wildheart abilities - not from a Way - with a combined XP cost of no more than 15.

Also choose one: Way of the Hive, Way of the Green, Way of the Spore, Way of the Tooth, and one ability from the chosen school costing no more than 5 XP.
novizio.spellcasting: Any metal worn on your body blocks your ability to use magic.
novizio.gratuiti: Pouches of soil, bark, twigs, moss, dried herbs or mushrooms. Simple, rough garments of animal skins or woven plants.
